name: ycgNem
tagline: Play it now. See how it's made.
description: ycgNem makes free browser games with AI and shows the whole process: every repo public, every number on screen, every patch noted.
_spotlight_help: The big switcher at the top of the home page, 1 to 4 games. game = an id from games.json; kicker = the amber line under the title; short = the line on its tab; image = a 1280x720 screenshot; link = where 'What's new' goes.
_socials_help: Paste each profile URL once the account exists. Empty ones are hidden on the site.
_giscus_help: Comments on game pages and devlog posts. Fill these from https://giscus.app after enabling Discussions on this repo (see SETUP.md). Leave repoId empty to hide comments.
